label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), previous trial rewarded, early in episode
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (99% of mass; never at D1, a trace at GO) when the agent chose a2 and landed in S2 via the common transition (in_action=2, in_state=2: 97% of mass). It is strongly gated by episode time: active through ep_trial ~0-55 and silent after trial ~60, so it seems to follow a slow drift in hidden state across the episode rather than anything about the task. Inside that window it prefers trials that follow a rewarded trial (prev_reward=1). Magnitude is highest during long runs of rewarded a2->S2c trials and when the model value is high (87% of mass at value > 8.1). It does not fire for a1 choices, for S1 states, for rare transitions, or late in episodes. All variables used are observed at D2. Dev F1 0.78 (P 0.84, R 0.73, mass recall 0.85). Without the reward condition, recall is 0.88 but precision is 0.64. The ep_trial cutoff is an empirical proxy.
